positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalCadenceAndOwnership
positions.frame: how are Atlas rollback rehearsals scheduled and owned to maintain operational readiness?
positions.why: Quinton's mandate establishing a monthly rehearsal cadence grounded in the principle that unrehearsed recovery procedures are non-existent (src-1) is codified into operational specifications for cadence (src-2) and assigned drill ownership (src-3).
